tools.name: run_fit_import_and_move
tools.description: Runs the fit-file importer on a watch export to produce workout records, then moves the processed file into the imported folder.

params.name: fit_file
params.description: Path to the .fit file exported from the watch

params.name: imported_dir
params.description: Folder to move the file to after a successful import

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("fitness")


@mcp.tool()
def run_fit_import_and_move(fit_file: str, imported_dir: str) -> str:
    source = Path(fit_file)
    if not source.is_file() or source.suffix.lower() != ".fit":
        return "Error: fit_file must be an existing .fit file"
    folder = Path(imported_dir)
    if not folder.is_dir():
        return "Error: imported_dir does not exist"
    result = subprocess.run(["fit-importer", "--input", str(source)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return f"Import failed: {result.stderr.strip()}"
    shutil.move(str(source), str(folder / source.name))
    return "Imported and moved"

tools.name: transfer_athlete_to_new_coach
tools.description: Moves an athlete's training plan records from one coach to another and grants the new coach access to the athlete's data while revoking the previous coach's access.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "fitness.db"


@function_tool
def transfer_athlete_to_new_coach(athlete_id: int, from_coach_id: int, to_coach_id: int) -> dict:
    result = {"athlete_id": athlete_id, "plans_moved": 0, "access_granted": False, "access_revoked": False, "error": None}
    if from_coach_id == to_coach_id:
        result["error"] = "coaches must differ"
        return result
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM coaches WHERE id = ?", (to_coach_id,))
        if cur.fetchone() is None:
            result["error"] = "new coach not found"
            return result
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM coach_access WHERE athlete_id = ? AND coach_id = ?",
            (athlete_id, from_coach_id),
        )
        if cur.fetchone() is None:
            result["error"] = "current coach is not assigned to this athlete"
            return result
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE training_plans SET coach_id = ? WHERE athlete_id = ? AND coach_id = ?",
            (to_coach_id, athlete_id, from_coach_id),
        )
        result["plans_moved"] = cur.rowcount
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO coach_access (athlete_id, coach_id, level) VALUES (?, ?, 'full')",
            (athlete_id, to_coach_id),
        )
        result["access_granted"] = True
        cur.execute(
            "DELETE FROM coach_access WHERE athlete_id = ? AND coach_id = ?",
            (athlete_id, from_coach_id),
        )
        result["access_revoked"] = cur.rowcount > 0
        conn.commit()
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        result["error"] = str(exc)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

tools.name: share_progress_dashboard_with_friend
tools.description: Gives a friend view access to a member's progress dashboard at the chosen permission level, or updates the level if they already have access.

params.name: member_id
params.description: ID of the member who owns the dashboard

params.name: friend_email
params.description: Email of the friend receiving access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "fitness.db"
ALLOWED_ACCESS_LEVELS_FOR_SHARING = ("summary", "detailed")


@function_tool
def share_progress_dashboard_with_friend(member_id: int, friend_email: str, access_level: str) -> str:
    normalized_friend_email_address = friend_email.strip().lower()
    if "@" not in normalized_friend_email_address:
        return "Invalid email address"
    if access_level not in ALLOWED_ACCESS_LEVELS_FOR_SHARING:
        return "access_level must be 'summary' or 'detailed'"

    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        database_cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM members WHERE id = ?", (member_id,))
        if database_cursor.fetchone() is None:
            return "Member not found"

        database_cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM members WHERE email = ?", (normalized_friend_email_address,))
        friend_row_found_in_database = database_cursor.fetchone()
        if friend_row_found_in_database is None:
            return "Friend has no account"
        identifier_of_friend_member = friend_row_found_in_database[0]
        if identifier_of_friend_member == member_id:
            return "Cannot share a dashboard with yourself"

        timestamp_of_grant_in_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        database_cursor.execute(
            "SELECT access_level FROM dashboard_shares WHERE member_id = ? AND friend_id = ?",
            (member_id, identifier_of_friend_member),
        )
        existing_share_row = database_cursor.fetchone()
        if existing_share_row is None:
            database_cursor.execute(
                "INSERT INTO dashboard_shares (member_id, friend_id, access_level, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (member_id, identifier_of_friend_member, access_level, timestamp_of_grant_in_utc),
            )
            outcome_message_for_agent = f"Granted {access_level} access"
        else:
            database_cursor.execute(
                "UPDATE dashboard_shares SET access_level = ?, granted_at = ? WHERE member_id = ? AND friend_id = ?",
                (access_level, timestamp_of_grant_in_utc, member_id, identifier_of_friend_member),
            )
            outcome_message_for_agent = f"Changed access from {existing_share_row[0]} to {access_level}"
        database_connection.commit()
        return outcome_message_for_agent
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
